relationships.subject: ACC neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: We show that ACC activation strongly excites claustral fast-spiking inhibitory neurons, which leads to feedforward inhibition of claustrum neurons in adult mice.

relationships.subject: claustrum parvalbumin interneurons
relationships.evidence_quote: This feedforward inhibition is reduced by chemogenetic suppression of claustral parvalbumin interneurons.

key_findings: In adult mice ACC input excites claustral fast-spiking interneurons causing feedforward inhibition
Switch from ACC-claustrum excitation to inhibition correlates with emergence of claustrum parvalbumin neurons in postnatal week 3
